# permio_group_member (Resource)

One member of a group. This resource is **non-authoritative**: it only manages its own membership and leaves other members alone, so several `permio_group_member` resources (and members added outside Terraform) can coexist on one group.

Do not use it on a group that is also managed by `permio_group_members`, which removes every member it does not list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "permio_group" "oncall" {
  name = "oncall"
}

# Non-authoritative: adds one member and leaves any others alone.
# Do not combine with permio_group_members on the same group.
resource "permio_group_member" "alice" {
  group     = permio_group.oncall.name
  principal = "user_alice"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group` (String) Name (slug) of the group, for example `permio_group.engineering.name`.
- `principal` (String) Principal ID of the member. Group principals (`group:...`) are not allowed.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project the object belongs to. Defaults to the provider's `project`. Changing it replaces the object. API keys are scoped to one project, so this must be the key's project.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<project>/<group>/<principal>`, which is also the import ID.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Imported by "<project>/<group>/<principal>". The project is required.
# Project and group names cannot contain "/", so the ID is split at the first two "/" and the principal
# is the rest, which may itself contain "/".
terraform import permio_group_member.alice default/oncall/user_alice
terraform import permio_group_member.bob default/oncall/user/bob@example.com
```
